findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The facility could benefit from a detail cleaning. There is observed soil accumulation around certain floors and walls throughout the facility. Also, accumulation was observed beneath and around large pieces of equipment. Ensure that detail cleaning occurs as often as necessary to prevent debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
A storage rack that stores freshly baked bread appeared to not have a covering on the top. Discussed with PIC and a baking sheet was placed on the top of the rack. Ensure that a baking sheet or any type of covering is placed over the rack whenever bread is being stored to protect against contamination.   

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The facility is in need of a deep cleaning. The floors, walls, and ceilings of both the back and the front of the house are accumulated with food/liquid splatter, dust, and overall debris. Ensure that all physical facilities are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent soil accumulation. When cleaning, be sure to pull equipment that has wheels from the wall to throughly clean floors and walls.  


6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
